meta.title: A vendor cannot list the line items of a draft event
gaps: The request targets chat reference options rather than the read_line_items operation, so the line-items listing response is not directly checked.
warnings: act 1: the vendor is not invited to this setup — it acts as an outsider

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and an RFQ (pricing) round attached, not published.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the chats get reference options request, the request the case itself writes.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not authorized to perform this action”, and never with a server error.
